full_judgment:
This Rule is directed against the Judgment and decree dated 6-4-2000 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Feni, in Title Appeal No. 18 of 1997 allowing the appeal, sending the suit back on remand on setting aside the judgment and decree dated 27-2-1997 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Feni, in Title Suit No. 35 of 1979 dismissing the suit. 

 4. The trial Court on consideration of the evidence on record dismissed the suit by the judgment and decree dated 27-2-1997. 

 5. Being aggrieved by the judgment and decree, the plaintiff preferred Title Appeal No. 18 of 1997 and the said appeal was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Feni, who by the impugned Judgment and decree dated 6-4-2000 allowed the appeal, sent the suit back on remand on setting aside the judgment of the trial Court and directing the trial Court in allowing the plaintiff to hold a local investigation to ascertain as to whether the road has been constructed upon the plot No. 3004 or 3003. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the impugned judgment and decree, the defendant Nos. 1-3 have obtained the instant Rule. 

 11. In the result, the Rule is discharged, however without any order as to costs. The judgment and decree dated 6-4-2000 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Feni, in Title Appeal No. 18 of 1997 allowing the appeal, sending the suit back on remand on setting aside the judgment and decree dated 27-2-1997 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Feni, in Title Suit No. 35 of 1979 is hereby affirmed.
